title: Hourly InfluenceWatch One America location-semantics pass
summary: Seeded InfluenceWatch pass preserves One America Movement's Bowie address as first-party donation/mailing evidence rather than silently promoting InfluenceWatch's headquarters label; a bounded headquarters-designation target is queued and no filler news event is added.

provenance.method: dataset-first seeded selection, public organizational location semantic audit, current-news scan

diversity_exclusions: dark-academia:immediately preceding recovered ECFR hourly transaction
metadata.selected_target: One America Movement / headquarters-location semantic reconciliation
metadata.target_count: not asserted; complete executable frontier unavailable through connector search alone

data.research_question: Can a current InfluenceWatch headquarters field be reconciled against first-party location evidence without collapsing mailing-address and headquarters semantics?
data.method: Applied seeded dataset-first selection; selected a current InfluenceWatch organization profile; compared InfluenceWatch, One America Movement first-party donation/contact/hiring surfaces, and current public nonprofit filing index; searched current 2026 news and organization activity through 2026-08-19.
classification_rules: Secondary-source headquarters labels remain attributed until first-party or authoritative evidence supports the same semantic.
A donation-mailing address is not silently promoted to headquarters.
Job geography is not headquarters evidence.
No news record is created when current search adds no material location event or correction.

findings.finding: InfluenceWatch labels the Bowie address as headquarters, while One America Movement's current first-party donation page publishes the same address specifically for mailed donations.
Current first-party contact and 2026 hiring surfaces do not independently establish the Bowie address as headquarters; the hiring surface uses Washington, DC Metro Area.
Current-news searches through 2026-08-19 found active 2026 organization activity but no material headquarters relocation/designation event; no filler event was ingested.
